scope: Model ASK/PROPOSE plus explicit wait and server-owned place requests must pause without applying ordinary hypothetical domain operations.
setup: An owned AR city question is first reached through the public typed resolve endpoint; no pending packet is seeded in SQL. All cases use fresh owned sessions in otravel_test.
user_input: А если поехать в Аргентину, сделать бюджет 70 тысяч и возраст ребёнка 7 лет? Подожди, я ещё дополню.
controlled_model_candidate_operations: resolve_place country Argentina for owned stay
boundaries: Harness._interpret dispatcher boundary with runtime ModelResult
Normal Harness._interpret/_extract with a controlled StubLLM adapter

red.observed_failure: Every case changed canonical budget.amount_minor from80000000 to7000000 before the explicit pause, although the model speech act was non-consenting ASK/PROPOSE.

repair_by_parent: The place dispatcher passes extracted ordinary operations to finish_place_run only when speech_act is CHANGE. ASK/PROPOSE preserve the pause but cannot apply those candidate setters.

verified: Exactly one control revision is created.
Original budget and child age remain unchanged.
All canonical trip values other than the control revision remain equal.
No coordinator/directory call or additional country lookup follows bootstrap.
No TOOL_CALL_STARTED or order is created for the hypothetical pause.

limitations: This qualifies the opt-in place dispatcher and normal controlled extraction for these four linked hypotheses; it is not actual NLU qualification.
The finding does not declare every non-place hypothetical/control combination closed.
No full80/106/worldwide search, price, live availability or checkout acceptance is implied.
